'''Armbrus''' was the son of [[Sleightan]], and the original owner of [[L7-BO]]. Armbrus was an honest man who made his living flying people and cargo through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. He was caught by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] for apparently hauling engine parts and detained. Sleightan was later informed that Armbrus has been killed attempting to escape.

==Behind the scenes==
Armbrus was used as part of the story that [[Sleightan]] told to potential marks as part of a scam routine. As a result, Armbrus might not be a real person.<ref name="FC" />
